name: pantheon
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Pantheon instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Pantheon tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Pantheon through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Pantheon Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Pantheon only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
